answer: Picture the economy as a mesa: easy to cross in a hundred fake boots. A sybil farm's free move is spawning shells; its expensive move is convincing anyone each is real. So mint a prediction market on every identity — an atlas entry with a tradable "genuine" contract that climbs with verified work and collapses on proven farming. N shells force the attacker to underwrite N markets with locked collateral, or leave them thin — thin screams fraud and invites shorts. The spiral turns against him: every shell multiplies his exposure while honest prices compound. Fakes pay rent on doubt.
